{{Sexagenary cycle}}

'''Yin Wood Pig''' (乙亥, ''kinoto i''; onyomi ''otsugai'') is the 12th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 12th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Wood Dog|ja|甲戌}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Fire Rat|ja|丙子}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''乙'' is Yin Wood, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''亥'' (Pig) is Yin Water; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Wood Pig (乙亥)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): yǐhài
** Cantonese (Jyutping): jyut3 hoi6
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: kinoto-i
*** On'yomi: otsugai
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): eulhae (을해)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Ất Hợi

==Months of Yin Wood Pig==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 4 or 9 (corresponding to the heavenly stems {{ill|Kinoe (甲)|ja|甲|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kou}} or {{ill|Tsuchinoto (己)|ja|己|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ki}}), the month of {{ill|October|en|October|qid=Q124|lt=October}} is designated as the Etsugai {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the seasonal month (from {{ill|Lidong|en|Lidong|qid=Q1191018|lt=Beginning of Winter}} until the day before {{ill|Daxue (solar term)|en|Daxue (solar term)|qid=Q337815|lt=Heavy Snow}}) as applicable.

==Days of Yin Wood Pig==
The {{ill|Senjitsu|ja|選日|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/selected day}} for Etsugai is as follows.
=== Selected Day (選日) ===
Etsugai day is the 6th day of the {{ill|Tsuchi (Japanese term)|ja|犯土|lt=Hando|lt_ja=大土|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hando|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11571306}} period.
